body: Hyperstock is a modern multi-asset trading platform designed to give traders access to a broad range of financial markets through one account.
Depending on availability and eligibility, traders can access stocks, cryptocurrencies, gold, mutual funds, and other supported products.
Our platform brings market access, trading tools, portfolio management, account funding, and market information together in one streamlined experience.

whoCanOpen.q: Who can open a Hyperstock account?
body: Hyperstock is designed for eligible individuals who meet our account-opening and verification requirements.
Account eligibility may depend on factors such as your location, age, identity verification, account profile, and the specific trading products you wish to access.
Additional requirements may apply to certain accounts and services.

howToOpen.q: How do I open an account?
body: Opening a Hyperstock account is designed to be straightforward.
Create your account, provide the required information, complete the applicable verification process, and submit any requested documentation.
Once your account has been approved, you can fund your account and begin trading available markets.

whyVerify.q: Why does Hyperstock need to verify my identity?
body: Identity verification helps Hyperstock establish a secure and compliant trading relationship with each client.
Because Hyperstock serves elite, high-net-worth, and sophisticated traders, verification may involve additional checks depending on the nature and value of the account.
The information required may include your legal name, date of birth, residential address, and government-issued identification.

documents.q: What documents may I need to provide?
body: Verification requirements depend on your account and trading relationship with Hyperstock.
You may be asked to provide a valid government-issued identification document and information necessary to confirm your identity and account details.
For high-net-worth and elite clients, additional documentation may be requested where necessary to establish and maintain the trading relationship.

howLong.q: How long does account verification take?
body: Verification times vary depending on the account and the information required.
Many applications can be reviewed promptly. More detailed verification for high-net-worth or elite trading accounts may require additional review before approval.
Providing accurate information and complete documentation helps keep the process moving efficiently.

howToFund.q: How can I fund my Hyperstock account?
body: Available funding methods depend on your location, account, and applicable trading services.
Once your account has been approved, available funding options will be displayed within your Hyperstock account.
Processing times and applicable limits may vary by funding method.

depositTime.q: How long does it take for my deposit to arrive?
body: Deposit processing times depend on the funding method used.
Some deposits may become available quickly, while others may require additional processing before they can be used for trading.
Applicable processing information will be displayed through the platform.

howToWithdraw.q: How do I withdraw money from my account?
body: You can request a withdrawal through your Hyperstock account using an available withdrawal method.
Withdrawals may require account verification and standard processing procedures before funds are released.
Available withdrawal methods and processing information are displayed within your account.

limits.q: Are there limits on deposits or withdrawals?
body: Certain accounts, funding methods, products, or transactions may have applicable minimums or maximums.
Limits may vary based on your account, verification status, funding method, and applicable requirements.
Any applicable limits will be communicated through the platform.

whatCanInvest.q: What can I trade through Hyperstock?
body: Hyperstock provides access to multiple markets through one trading platform.
Depending on availability and account eligibility, supported products may include:

list: Stocks: Shares of publicly traded companies
Gold: Access to supported gold-related products
Mutual Funds: Professionally managed investment funds

body: The availability of specific products may vary by account and jurisdiction.

sameAccount.q: Can I trade stocks and cryptocurrencies from the same account?
body: Yes. Where both products are available to your account, Hyperstock allows you to access and manage multiple markets through one connected trading experience.
You can monitor your positions, manage your portfolio, and trade eligible assets without maintaining separate Hyperstock accounts for each supported market.
Fractional share availability depends on the security and the applicable product offering.
Where supported, traders may be able to purchase a portion of an eligible share rather than a full share.
Availability, minimum amounts, and applicable restrictions may vary.

anyTime.q: Can I trade at any time?
body: Trading hours depend on the market and product.
Stocks generally follow established exchange trading hours, while certain markets, including cryptocurrency markets, may operate on different schedules.
The Hyperstock platform will display applicable trading availability for supported products.
Hyperstock provides trading tools, market information, research, and access to financial products.
Information available through the platform is intended to help traders research and evaluate market opportunities. It should not automatically be considered personalized financial advice.
If you require personalized advice based on your individual circumstances, you should consult an appropriately qualified financial professional.

howProtected.q: How does Hyperstock protect my account?
body: Security is built into every layer of the Hyperstock trading experience.

We use security controls designed to protect your account, personal information, and trading activity. These may include encryption, authentication controls, account monitoring, and measures designed to identify unusual activity.
We also recommend keeping your login credentials private and using all available account-security features.

suspicious.q: What should I do if I notice suspicious activity?
body: Contact Hyperstock Support as soon as possible and secure your account.
If you notice an unfamiliar login, transaction, withdrawal, or other activity you do not recognize, follow the security instructions available through your account.
Never share your password, authentication codes, wallet recovery phrases, or other private security information with anyone claiming to represent Hyperstock.
Fees depend on the product, transaction, funding method, and service involved.

Applicable fees are presented through the platform and relevant disclosures. Depending on the service, these may include trading charges, spreads, fund expenses, withdrawal fees, payment-processing fees, or other applicable costs.
Review the applicable fee information before completing a transaction.

riskFree.q: Is trading with Hyperstock guaranteed to be profitable?
body: No trading platform can guarantee a particular trading outcome.
Market prices can change quickly, and the outcome of a trade depends on factors including the asset, market conditions, timing, and execution.
Hyperstock provides the tools and market access to help traders make informed decisions, while each trader remains responsible for their own trading activity.
